# Controller 1.0.51 (92)
## Factory Droid Subagents & Missions
- Droid SDK `Task` and `SpawnAgent` delegations appear as subagent rows, with live child session hydration and streaming, per-task Stop, and a wake when background work finishes after the turn ends. - Droid `TodoWrite` checklists render as native Controller plans. - Missions are available from `/mission` and a new `Workflow` selector (`Build` / `Mission`) on the model card. Mission proposals arrive as review cards, including under Full access, and milestones and workers show as workflow progress phases on Mac, iPhone, iPad, and Android.
## Sidebars & Inspector
- The sidebar has clean editorial thread rows with `Pinned`, `Active`, and collapsible `Settled` shelves, a soft scroll-edge fade, and a unified Liquid Glass footer dock. - The Inspector adds interactive glass capsules for `Overview`, `Files`, `Changes`, `Browser`, and `Terminal`.
## Files, Browser & Pull Requests
- A unified Files + Diff explorer with an inline `Code | Diff` toggle on modified files. - The browser uses a compact Safari-style Liquid Glass omnibox and tab strip. - Pull request review has a compact two-row header with release and tag readiness.
Includes matching iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android build 92.

# Controller 1.0.51 (90)
## Orchestration & Automation
- Subagent context-window budget telemetry now tracks live token usage and warns as child sessions approach capacity. - Idle high-context sessions compact automatically in the background with safe cooldown and active-turn guards. - Pull requests opened from terminal commands (`gh pr create`, `glab mr create`) link to the active thread automatically. - Per-thread dev servers follow worktree cleanup and restart cleanly across worktree handoffs. - Provider usage-limit errors now parse reset windows, sleep with a live countdown, and resume turns automatically when quota resets. - Interactive `request_secret` prompts collect secrets directly into Keychain on Mac and iPhone without exposing values in chat transcripts. - Inline PR review guides and ephemeral review findings render alongside diffs, and worktree setup scripts stream live progress with one-click retry.
## Controller Connect
- Live guest thread sharing lets you share a read-only web link (including inline screenshots) and review guest messages before sending them to the agent. - Same-LAN connections prefer direct encrypted local sockets over tunnel hops when healthy, with on-demand external tunnel reachability probes on Mac and iPhone. - Coalesced GitHub webhook hints wake pull-request watchers without blind polling, with replay deduplication and wildcard event filters. - `controller://` deep links and environment invite URLs open threads and pair hosts directly on Mac and iPhone, and host main-thread stalls surface in Connect diagnostics.
Includes matching iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android build 90.

# Controller 1.0.51 (89)
## Much lighter while agents work
- The activity orb's typing dots, the running-step shimmer, the streaming caret and subagent marks now animate in Core Animation. A window with a running turn uses about 0.3% of the main thread, down from 15–55%. - The orb's dots-to-check morph now plays when a turn finishes, on the Mac and iPhone. - Mac hang reporting pauses while update alerts and open panels are shown, and MetricKit diagnostics now reach crash reporting.
## Reliability
- Fixed crashes in the Apple documentation bridge and leaks in the terminal, browser and simulator when threads are deleted. - Connect pins device signing keys on first use, fails closed if a pinned key changes, and rotates host identity on sign-out or account switch. - Fixed connections to other Macs giving up before they started, and restarted tunnel backoff once the host is reachable again. - Agent Memory sync keeps project scopes intact across Macs, and Dream runs no longer overlap. - Fixes for the Codex, Claude, Cursor, Droid, Pi and Muse harnesses.
## Interface
- The sidebar now defaults to the Title First row layout. - Destructive Mac actions ask for confirmation, icon-only controls have labels, and more views honor Reduce Motion. - Review Changes opens Last Commit on a clean checkout on every platform.
## iPhone, Apple Watch and Android
- iPhone terminal polling, empty states and the diff picker were fixed; dictation cleans up when cancelled. - Apple Watch answers server questions and stays in sync with the phone. - Android: more reliable Connect sign-in and sign-out, Live Updates that survive going offline, Back closes expanded glass overlays, interrupted update downloads recover, photo orientation is respected, and background polling stops.
Includes matching iPhone, iPad, Apple Watch, and Android build 89.
